description: This file defines the 'Collector' interface and related helper functions and types for collecting and describing metrics in the Prometheus client library. It includes interface methods, a helper function, and internal implementations for metrics that are also collectors.

classes.name: selfCollector
classes.description: Implements Collector for a single Metric, allowing the Metric to collect itself.

classes.name: collectorMetric
classes.description: An interface combining Metric and Collector, representing metrics that are also collectors.

methods.name: DescribeByCollect
methods.description: Helper function to implement the Describe method by collecting metrics and sending their descriptors.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a selfCollector with a specific Metric.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Implements the Collector interface to send the Metric's descriptor.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Implements the Collector interface to send the Metric itself.
